content.text: Watch the entire clip carefully. Describe only what the wearer's left hand visibly does. Track the fingertips, contacted object, direction, and state change. Do not infer specifications, intentions or unseen outcomes. Return JSON with visible_action (at most 40 words) and uncertainty (at most 20 words).

result.visible_action: The wearer's left hand holds a cylindrical object steady while the right hand uses a tool to adjust or tighten a component on the object.
result.uncertainty: The exact nature of the adjustment or tightening action is unclear due to limited visibility of the tool's interaction.
